method: Primary vendor/release sources browsed; exact release commits checked through GitHub contents API; retained tested-bundle metadata inspected read-only. No app launched, installed, or upgraded.

Paseo.license_version_suffix_note: Apache-2.0 has no -only/-or-later suffix in the published expression. Third-party carve-outs are separate component licenses, not an SPDX WITH exception.
Paseo.short_primary_excerpt: Except for those third-party components, Paseo is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
Paseo.source_vs_distribution: The first-party license text covers Paseo, including Source/Object-form grants. Installed desktop package metadata also declares Apache-2.0; no differing first-party desktop distribution license was established.
Paseo.caveat: Bundled third-party components retain their own copyright-holder licenses. This is the first-party app license, not a complete dependency SPDX expression or trademark grant; installed binary bytes were not matched to a release asset hash.

local_corroboration.artifact: Retained extraction of installed desktop app package.json

Sheprd.license_version_suffix_note: Apache-2.0 is the exact workspace declaration; no -only/-or-later or WITH suffix is declared for the first-party app.
Sheprd.short_primary_excerpt: licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
Sheprd.source_vs_distribution: The exact tested desktop bundle ships the same LICENSE and NOTICE as the release source commit. Its first-party software is Apache-2.0; the binary also bundles separately licensed dependencies/assets.
Sheprd.caveat: NOTICE separately identifies MIT themes and CC-BY-4.0 Codicons, among other third-party attributions. HERDR-CORE-LICENSES.txt and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt are shipped too. Apache-2.0 is not asserted as the sole license of every binary component.

distribution_evidence.scope: Read-only image metadata inspection only; no app launched or image installed. Absence of an embedded DMG SLA is not proof that no other terms exist.

Agentastic.source_vs_distribution: An MIT grant does not establish publication of preferred source code. The vendor publishes MIT wording and separately describes its desktop app as closed source; these are distinct observations. The tested 0.16.2 binary-specific EULA/license applicability remains unverified.
Agentastic.caveat: Do not label the app proprietary solely because no public source repo was found, and do not label it publicly source-available solely because the website publishes an MIT notice. No separate terms for hosted Agentastic.com services were established here.
Agentastic.recommended_display_label: MIT · closed source (published notice; binary version scope unverified)

open_source_grade_note: Agentastic public source availability remains a separate question from the published MIT license notice; no manifest grades were edited.
